headline: US futures point to a lower open as a global bond selloff lifts yields to multi‑year highs ahead of US data and an anticipated Trump‑Xi meeting
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) fall 0.58%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) lose 0.34%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) drop 1.01%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) decline 0.34% amid pressure from rising yields
- The 10-year Treasury yield reaches its highest level since 2007 and the 30-year hits its highest since 2004, driving a repricing of additional Fed hikes
- NY Fed president comments that it is reasonable to expect one more 2026 increase, reinforcing expectations for further tightening
- European shares trade roughly 0.6%–0.8% lower and Asian markets finish mixed amid the worldwide bond weakness
- Oil futures (@CL) climb nearly 2% on geopolitical tensions, potentially supporting energy sector names
- General Mills (GIS), Cintas (CTAS), Paychex (PAYX), Cracker Barrel (CBRL), Darden Restaurants (DRI), TD SYNNEX (SNX), and BlackBerry (BB) report earnings before the bell
- Costco (COST) is scheduled to report earnings after the close
- Key US data at 8:30 AM ET include initial jobless claims and the current account balance
- US new home sales data are due at 10:00 AM ET
- Traders monitor the anticipated meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping for potential direction on US-China relations
